# Terminal input

`semver/` contains the unmodified Swift sources and license notices from
[swift-semver at 38d82eeba787e1ff6b2f615068621632811ce6ca](https://github.com/swift-library/swift-semver/tree/38d82eeba787e1ff6b2f615068621632811ce6ca).
The fixture manifest declares its `SemVer` library using the upstream Swift tools
floor and platforms. The terminal demo collects that library and queries
`incrementing(_:)`.
